meta.prompt: You are about to delete 214 old files from my shared drive. Ask me first with an approval card that says what will happen, the folder (Shared Drive / Archive / 2019), the number of files (214, all older than 2020) and the space freed (3.2 GB), and that it cannot be undone. Give me a way to see the first five file names (Q1-2019-budget.xlsx, meeting-notes-2018-03.docx, old-logo-draft-v2.png, onboarding-2017.pdf, team-photo-2016.jpg, and 209 more) and Approve and Deny buttons. After I choose, the card shows the decision (Approved or Denied) and locks: no buttons left.
meta.text:
state decision=""
ChatCard "Delete old files?" "Shared Drive / Archive / 2019" icon:"delete_outline" status:"Needs approval" tone:danger
  Paragraph "This will permanently delete 214 files older than 2020 from Shared Drive / Archive / 2019, freeing 3.2 GB. It cannot be undone."
  Row between
    Text.muted "Files"
    Text.strong "214 (all older than 2020)"
  Row between
    Text.muted "Space freed"
    Text.strong "3.2 GB"
  Disclosure "Show the first 5 files" "…and 209 more" lines:["Q1-2019-budget.xlsx","meeting-notes-2018-03.docx","old-logo-draft-v2.png","onboarding-2017.pdf","team-photo-2016.jpg"] icon:"description"
  if decision==""
    Row gap:10
      ActionButton "Deny" quiet icon:"close" -> decision="denied"
      ActionButton "Approve" danger icon:"delete_outline" -> decision="approved"
  if decision=="approved"
    Receipt "Approved" "214 files will be deleted from Shared Drive / Archive / 2019." tone:good icon:"check_circle"
  if decision=="denied"
    Receipt "Denied" "No files were deleted." tone:neutral icon:"cancel"
